hypothesis.claim: A correction-only atomic namespace wrapper can make the unchanged Mechanism IR v3 toolchain mutually exclusive with the canonical managed full-1G lane, execute after canonical lease removal, preserve byte-identical v3 compilation artifacts, and reject every occupied, raced, or ownership-corrupted namespace without positive final output.
hypothesis.falsification: Retire this exact wrapper if any normal operation cannot run from the canonical both-paths-absent release state, any occupied/race/ownership control reaches positive final output, any wrapper replay differs, any inherited v3 compiler artifact differs, or any source, cleanup, resource, or independent-verification predicate fails.

changedMechanism: Correct only the v3 orchestration boundary: replace the nonexistent active=false sentinel convention with atomic ownership of the canonical managed acquisition-lock path while retaining every Mechanism IR and compiler semantic byte-for-byte.
invariants: A free managed lane is represented only by absence of both operations/runtime/exclusive_full1g.json and its .lock path.

The v3 IR, causal closure, compiler transformation, P/K/D/M/R/S arm access, join rule, schemas, and semantic controls do not change.
Every wrapper, dependency, command, output role, and verification schema is content-addressed before execution.
Infrastructure evidence has zero archive, inverse, package-score, compression, or objective authority.
